value.title: 设置多端同步
value.description: Patch Classic incremental sync configuration. url is HTTP(S), remotePath is a directory on that server, intervalMinutes >= 5, categories is nonempty. Omitted fields stay unchanged. Changing url or username clears the old password; use sync.login. Does not enable synchronization.

value.title: 设置自动同步
value.description: Set enabled true or false. Enable immediately syncs like Classic. Returns jobId; use task.wait for its result. Disabling stops scheduled runs; an already active run completes.

value.title: 登录同步服务器
value.description: Open NipaPlay for the user to enter the sync server password. No secret input is accepted. Test before saving. Returns a jobId; use task.wait. task.cancel closes the password window.

value.title: 管理服务器地址
value.description: List or modify Classic server addresses in one batch. sourceId must be Jellyfin/Emby. Omit operations to list without connecting. Each operation: add(url,name), remove(addressId), switch(addressId), priority(addressId,priority), check(addressId). add verifies server identity. check probes public identity before reusing this profile session, records success/failure and does not switch. Cannot remove the last address; removing the current address first switches to a remaining enabled address. Results are in input order; failure stops the batch after earlier operations have applied.

value.title: 管理共享文件夹
value.description: Manage peer scan roots in bulk. operation add takes folders[{path,scan=true,skipPreviouslyMatchedUnwatched=false}]; scan uses the same fields with scan=true. remove takes paths[]. rescan uses skipPreviouslyMatchedUnwatched=true by default; cleanup removes missing roots. These remove metadata, never disk files. No confirmation. Results are ordered; earlier successful operations remain if a later one fails.

value.title: 管理共享连接
value.description: Manage peer WebDAV/SMB connections. operation configure takes connections[{type,name,url for WebDAV or host for SMB,username,port,domain}]; a nonempty username opens NipaPlay for user credentials; an empty username configures anonymous access directly. Returns jobId (task.wait/cancel). Existing same-name connections are replaced like Classic after successful testing. Other operations take type and names[]: remove/test. browse/scan take type, name and paths[] (remote directories). browse forces fresh listing; scan uses Classic recognition. Passwords are never accepted or returned.

value.title: 播放远程影片
value.description: Play itemId returned by browse/query in the context of sourceId. Activates that Classic source first. Dandanplay remote and NipaPlay shared items retain Classic episode identity and resume context; credentials remain internal. Optional startPositionMs overrides resume. Returns the Classic player snapshot. Does not open a password prompt; log in first.

value.title: 识别远程媒体
value.description: Submit Classic WebDAV/SMB recursive video recognition from explicit paths[]. Uses Classic remote byte/hash matching, saved credentials and history. Requires the Classic Dandanplay matching account to be logged in. Preserves existing progress and migrates only previously cleared episode progress. Returns jobId; task.wait returns per-directory total/matched/failed counts. Cancellation stops between directories. This writes Classic matching/history; media.sources.sync only discovers files.

limitations: Erika native danmaku is not included, as with playback.capture.
Native video overlays and platform views outside the Flutter scene are not included.
The OS window frame, other windows and external players are not included.

result.consistency: Per-source observations of live state; no global transaction snapshot. Cursors paginate live observations.
